SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_material_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND material_id = #{id})

INSERT INTO tb_sales_quotation_hd (tenant_id, quotation_no, quotation_dt, submit_dt, customer_id, customer_reference, incoterms, payment_term, valid_term, currency_code, remark, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{quotationNo}, #{quotationDt,jdbcType=DATE,typeHandler=egovframework.com.cmm.LocalDateDateTypeHandler}, #{submitDt,jdbcType=DATE,typeHandler=egovframework.com.cmm.LocalDateDateTypeHandler}, #{customerId}, #{customerReference}, #{incoterms}, #{paymentTerm}, #{validTerm}, #{currencyCode}, #{remark}, #{supplyAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{vatAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{createdBy}) RETURNING quotation_id

INSERT INTO tb_sales_quotation_dt (quotation_id, tenant_id, line_no, material_id, material_code, material_name, material_spec, unit, quotation_qty, unit_price, line_amt, remark) VALUES (#{quotationId}, #{tenantId}, #{lineNo}, #{materialId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{materialSpec}, #{unit}, #{quotationQty,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{unitPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{lineAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{remark}) RETURNING quotation_detail_id

SELECT h.quotation_id AS quotationId, h.tenant_id AS tenantId, h.quotation_no AS quotationNo, h.quotation_dt AS quotationDt, h.submit_dt AS submitDt, h.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_code AS customerCode, c.customer_name AS customerName, h.customer_reference AS customerReference, h.incoterms, h.payment_term AS paymentTerm, h.valid_term AS validTerm, h.currency_code AS currencyCode, h.remark, h.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, h.vat_amt AS vatAmt, h.total_amt AS totalAmt, h.created_by AS createdBy, u.user_nm AS createdByName, la.profile_image AS createdByProfileImage, to_char(h.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM tb_sales_quotation_hd h LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_code = h.created_by AND la.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = la.login_id AND u.tenant_id = la.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.quotation_id = #{quotationId} AND h.use_at = 'Y'
SELECT h.created_by AS createdBy FROM tb_sales_quotation_hd h WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.quotation_id = #{quotationId} AND h.use_at = 'Y' FOR UPDATE OF h

SELECT d.quotation_detail_id AS quotationDetailId, d.quotation_id AS quotationId, d.tenant_id AS tenantId, d.line_no AS lineNo, d.material_id AS materialId, d.material_code AS materialCode, d.material_name AS materialName, d.material_spec AS materialSpec, d.unit, d.quotation_qty AS quotationQty, d.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.line_amt AS lineAmt, d.remark FROM tb_sales_quotation_dt d JOIN tb_sales_quotation_hd h ON h.quotation_id = d.quotation_id AND h.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND h.use_at = 'Y' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.quotation_id = #{quotationId} ORDER BY d.line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sales_quotation_hd SET quotation_dt = #{quotationDt,jdbcType=DATE,typeHandler=egovframework.com.cmm.LocalDateDateTypeHandler}, submit_dt = #{submitDt,jdbcType=DATE,typeHandler=egovframework.com.cmm.LocalDateDateTypeHandler}, customer_id = #{customerId}, customer_reference = #{customerReference}, incoterms = #{incoterms}, payment_term = #{paymentTerm}, valid_term = #{validTerm}, currency_code = #{currencyCode}, remark = #{remark}, supply_amt = #{supplyAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, vat_amt = #{vatAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, total_amt = #{totalAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND quotation_id = #{quotationId} AND use_at = 'Y' AND created_by = #{updatedBy}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_sales_quotation_dt WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND quotation_id = #{quotationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sales_quotation_hd SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND quotation_id = #{quotationId} AND use_at = 'Y' AND created_by = #{updatedBy}
mapper.select: SELECT h.quotation_id AS quotationId, h.quotation_no AS quotationNo, h.quotation_dt AS quotationDt, h.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_code AS customerCode, c.customer_name AS customerName FROM tb_sales_quotation_hd h JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND h.customer_id = #{customerId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND (h.quotation_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY h.quotation_dt DESC, h.quotation_id DESC
